description: A localeMatchSupplier handing the library a LocaleMatchResult built through its PUBLIC constructor with a NON-FINITE effective weight. LocaleMatchResult:111's first clause, the only one of its four that no JSON number can express -- the fixture carries the string sentinel 'infinity', which VectorOracle.fabricatedWeightFrom turns into Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY and lokalized-js's runner into the JS number Infinity. A JS caller reaches this state by writing `effectiveWeight: Infinity` or `NaN`, neither of which needs any deliberate effort.
